## 席位核对
ACCEPT — PR #36566 @ `1b5c106b24fee15cd29d549f807e437adaa6a840` · card #36452 · L1 read by area s2-D itself (seat area order item 9), at 2026-11-22T23:52Z

- Shape: draft → `main`; first line `Fixes #36452` (measure, then the cell face, then the document-face control: all three to-do items); no closing keyword on another card; `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none` in body and changeset.
- Premise (card item 1, measured by the dev at origin/main `87c7bbaf`): an `html` and a `richtext` value holding `<h1>` drew an `H1` in `tbody`; in Chromium with the compiled console stylesheet those rows were 45 px against 36 px. After the change: no heading element in `tbody`, all rows 36 px.
- Diff read (6 files, +211/−43): `HtmlCellRenderer` reads `inGridColumn` and in a grid column draws the sanitized tree with the cell face; the face class and the heading map move from `MarkdownContent.tsx` into `richTextDisplay.tsx` (`RICH_TEXT_CELL_FACE_CLASS`, `cellFaceHeadings`) and markdown imports them, one copy for both pipelines. `renderSanitizedHtml` gains an optional `components` map applied after `rehype-sanitize`; the allow and strip lists are unchanged. The removed `MARKDOWN_CELL_FACE_CLASS` had no reader outside its module (`git grep` at origin/main); none of the new names reaches the `@object-ui/fields` barrel.
- Forced test change, declared: `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.richTextOneLine-12480.test.tsx` asserted an `h2` inside the grid html cell (the behaviour this card removes); it now asserts `[data-html-heading]`. The claim's file surface was amended on #36452 before this review.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/fields` patch. `l1-face` flags `@object-ui/plugin-grid` with no entry; its only change is that test file, and the package ships `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `LICENSE` only (`files[]`), so nothing published changed; the CI Check Changeset is green.
- Tests: 6 new cases in `fields/.../markdownCellHeading-36344.test.tsx` and one grid-level pin through `ObjectGrid`; document-face CONTROLs for html and richtext. Ablation (face forced to `document`) ⇒ 6 red, 8 green, restored blob == HEAD.
- Gates: check-runs at `1b5c106b`: 44 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed (`pr-state.mjs --pr 36566`); 38 derived families reconciled 0 NOT-MEASURED (`/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/36452-gates-ran.txt`); `overlap-check` clean.
- Out of scope, not filed: the `CellRendererProps.inGridColumn` doc comment in `fields/src/index.tsx` still names only the date and markdown cells as readers (wording only; in the PR's Acceptance notes).
- Landing: `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 36566` ⇒ NOT governed, 254 lines ≤ 3000; no contract face ⇒ no L2 owed; K = 3 from merge base, and the PR changes no display label ⇒ area lands it.
